shared_elements: row of repeated figures forming a horizontal frieze
relief figures set against a plain ground
justification: Both surfaces show a horizontal frieze of profile quadrupeds combined with small schematic anthropomorphic figures whose limbs are splayed or raised, carved in relief against a blank ground. But A stacks several distinct registers (a top row of crouching beasts, a band of chevron/zigzag ornament, isolated predator, bird and snake-like forms) with figures that do not touch one another, whereas B shows a single continuous band of interlocked human figures with arms thrown up, mounted on or grasping the animals beside them.
